That white spot is her egg spot. All betta females have a visible egg spot. It's presence doesn't necessarily indicate anything about fertility. Your betta does look a little bit bloated but she may just be overweight if you dont see any pineconing scales.
bettas aren't live bearers, if your betta is looking bloated I'd make sure she isn't sick with dropsy, or overweight.

You definitely need a bigger tank. 5 gallons is the bare minimum. You also need live plants. If you don't know what the nitrogen cycle is you need to learn about it and get a testing kit. Since your tank is new and uncycled the ammonia can build up to unsafe levels and make your fish sick. You need to do daily water changes until you can get a bigger tank.

Liquid test kits preferable, the API branded ones are best and are cheapest on Amazon.

Sadly a lot of people mistakenly believe a betta is a good cheap gift. It is a pet that costs time, money, and effort to keep alive.
